notes: TVA standard rate 19% (CGI art. 226, DGI-hosted text of Loi 2012-37). The art. 219 exemption list (read in full) contains no gold or precious-metals item, so jewellery and bullion take 19%. Note: a recast CGI (Ordonnance 2025-22, effective 1 Jan 2026) could not be opened on an official page; the rate is as in the DGI-hosted code. Import duty HS 7108 null (UEMOA TEC line not openable).

sources.name: Direction Générale des Impôts - Code Général des Impôts, Loi n° 2012-37 (impots.gouv.ne)
sources.what: Read 2026-11-28: art. 226 sets the normal VAT rate at 19%; the art. 219 exemption list contains no gold, precious-metals or chapter-71 item
sources.quote: Art. 226- Le taux normal de la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée est de 19%.
